name: Being Prone
desc: A prone creature's only movement option is to crawl, which costs 1 extra foot per foot moved, unless it stands up and thereby ends the condition (standing costs half its speed). A prone creature has disadvantage on its own attack rolls. An attack roll against a prone creature has advantage if the attacker is within 5 feet; otherwise the attack roll has disadvantage.
